results.title: #SaveRose
results.overview: A young influencer decides to investigate her past after fainting at school. What she discovers puts not only her relationship with her overprotective mother at risk, but also her own life.

results.title: OSN: Giulio Cilona dirige il tradizionale Concerto di Natale 2025
results.original_title: OSN: Giulio Cilona dirige il tradizionale Concerto di Natale 2025
results.overview: From the Rai Arturo Toscanini Auditorium in Turin, Giulio Cilona conducts the Rai Orchestra’s Christmas Concert, featuring works by Vivaldi, Bach, Mozart, and Beethoven. The concert features Marco Braito and Roberto Rossi on trumpets and soprano Francesca Aspromonte.

results.title: Boiuna
results.overview: When mother and daughter return to an island in Pará, mysterious energies begin to haunt them. The two will need the strength of a giant to move forward.

results.title: The Breakpoint
results.overview: To save her mother's life, Telema finds herself in a living nightmare that pushes her to a breaking point that changes the lives of everyone involved. The mental health impacts of gender based violence shape the world of The Breakpoint.

results.title: American Mamas
results.overview: Following the results of the 2024 US Presidential Election, three Connecticut mothers discuss their fears but also their outlook for the future with trans-activist Tony Ferraiolo. For anyone feeling helpless or scared right now, this discussion is meant to be a source of hope.

results.title: Damn Handy
results.overview: When plumber Roger Clark visits the remote farmhouse of two murderous sisters, he'll need a trick up his sleeve to survive.

results.title: L'accord
results.overview: A night when Athens is "burning", three friends find shelter in an apartment building. When one of them needs help, they knock on the wrong door.

results.title: Deep Soup
results.overview: Digital technology is increasingly steering us towards a world of the mind, a frictionless existence that has become detached from our physical experience. With this film, post-humanist artists Luna Maurer and Roel Wouters attempt to turn the tide. They seek a way to lead people back from their screens to a bodily and material experience.  The duo invited people online to contribute their own videos on a variety of themes. Not of people, but only of matter and movement—breaking, rolling, sinking, floating, falling. All these clips go into the soup—a green physical intelligence that is trained on the collected images.  In Deep Soup, we see this non-human intelligence in its weightless world, processing this slurry of information. The result is a challenge to view physical reality with fresh eyes. A celebration of the forces that belong to our material world, which digital AI models and algorithms try to smooth out.

results.title: No Tears in Hell
results.overview: In the frozen darkness of an Alaskan winter, a mother and son turn their home into a house of nightmares — luring victims into a twisted web of abuse and cannibalism. Based on the terrifying true story of Russian serial killer Alexander Spesivtsev.

results.title: Freak Act
results.overview: As the light flickers out in a centuries-old theater, a new employee discovers there’s more to the building than meets the eye.

results.title: Deep into the Night
results.overview: After the loss of his wife, Ciro is a lost man. He wants to find the person who ran over and killed her on the road at night. In this search he loses himself, his sense of time and the possibility of allowing his 13-year-old son Luigi to live a normal life. The boy is thus forced to grow up fast to keep his father from descending into hell.

results.title: Aşkın Yüzü
results.overview: High school student Özgür has a rare disease: face blindness. When he meets Özlem, he feels a magical connection and wants to pursue love for the first time in his life. But his disease causes a huge problem that Özlem needs to solve.

results.title: Holloway
results.overview: Holloway — once the largest women's prison in Europe, now abandoned. Six ex-inmates revisit, recounting experiences, giving voice to incarcerated women. They explore vacant cells and corridors, recalling memories from their time inside.

results.title: Loner
results.overview: Loner follows an aspiring vlogger who retreats to an isolated cabin deep in the wilderness to rebuild his fractured sense of self, only to discover an ancient force lurking in the surrounding forest. As strange phenomena begin to escalate, his attempt at solitude spirals into a terrifying descent into paranoia and survival.  Directed by filmmaker duo Charlie Robb and Douglas Tawn, the film blends psychological horror, wilderness dread, and found-footage-style realism against the bleak backdrop of the British countryside. Debuting as a FoundTV exclusive, Loner delivers a slow-burning nightmare rooted in isolation, nature, and the fear of the unknown.

results.title: The Prep School Disappearance
results.overview: When a gifted prep school art student vanishes, her devoted teacher discovers a sketchbook filled with haunting drawings of a girl who soon arrives at the school as a new student, claiming the disappearance was no accident--and someone is hiding the truth.

results.title: Akin Ang Gabi
results.overview: A steamy tale of a young woman’s awakening. After her first encounter with her crush, Alexa learns to use her body to take control in a world that ignores her—until her secret life spirals into scandal and betrayal.

results.title: Nénuphar
results.overview: Maude invites her boyfriend Jérémy to her mother's villa. A dream vacation! And then, the feeling that an intruder is watching. Maude suspects her ex... Indeed, Félix is ​​jealous. Félix is ​​unstable. Félix is ​​completely crazy.

results.title: The Incredible Snow Woman
results.overview: Fired from her job, dumped by her partner, and in poor health, 46-year-old adventurer Coline Morel, a Far North specialist, sees her life falling apart. But "The Incredible Snow Woman" will attempt one last comeback.

results.title: Non-Player Character
results.overview: People go to work 5/2, have dinner and watch TV in the evening, stare at their phones before bed, quickly get ready in the morning and go to work. And again. And again. Again.

results.title: Moth & I
results.overview: Lucky Chan is an anxious real estate agent who is never lucky. Caught between nightmares and daydreams, he found his boner dry up on him.
